llm.guidance: This skill appears low-risk: it only prints static reference text and does not contact networks or request secrets. If you plan to install it, verify the publisher/source (bytesagain.com / the GitHub repo) if you require provenance. Note that the included script runs in a shell context — while safe in this case, always inspect included scripts before installing from any third party. Autonomous invocation is permitted by default, but here it has no access to sensitive resources.
